summary: Iter5 provider-centric browse/detail + profile edit fully validated. Backend: 12/12 new tests pass (test_providers.py) covering GET /api/providers, GET /api/providers/{id} incl. society_names resolution + 404, PUT /api/provider/profile RBAC + persistence + reflection on public page, POST /api/provider/apply guard, and end-to-end booking from provider services for both virtual (skips society) and physical (society_id required + validated) flows. Regression: existing 25/25 pass (test_categories_auth + test_slots_societies). Frontend (390x844 mobile): Home lists 4 provider cards, category-gym filter narrows to 1 (fit), clear resets to 4, search 'cricket' filters to 1, tapping provider card navigates to /app/provider/user_demoprov_fit, provider page renders name/rating/experience/bio/languages/certifications and per-service SlotPreview with resolved society names (Green Valley etc.). add-item / inc / dec / qty testids work; cart persists via uru_cart localStorage. Provider console 'My Profile' (nav-provider-profile) at /manage/provider/profile loads pre-populated fields; editing bio and saving persists (PUT /api/provider/profile) and reflects on the public provider page immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~848 lines - approaching maintainability threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, providers, services, bookings, admin, seed).
list_providers loops per-provider Mongo lookup (N+1). Small demo dataset is fine, but replace with a single users.find({'user_id': {'$in': ids}}) for scale.
_provider_summary returns hard-coded default rating=4.7 when missing; safe placeholder but should be documented or made explicit (e.g., 'rating_default': true) so UI can show '(new)'.

GET /api/providers/{id} allows admin (role=admin) to be fetched as a provider even without provider_status=approved - probably intentional but note this exposes admin user metadata publicly (email/phone). Consider excluding admins or restricting fields.
Public provider detail returns phone number without auth - if PII is a concern, gate this behind login.
ProviderPage cart integration: adding an item from a *different* provider silently replaces the cart (single-service design). Consider a UX confirm toast when switching.
Onboard/Profile use naive comma split via toArr - trims but does not dedupe; harmless.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 flows: home list, category filter, clear, search, provider detail nav, slot/society render, cart add/inc/dec, profile edit + public reflection)
